title: Short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk in LGI1-antibody encephalitis
title_zh: LGI1抗体脑炎的短期结果、长期残疾与复发风险
abstract: Abstract Leucine-rich glioma-inactivated-1 antibody encephalitis (LGI1-Ab-E) is a common and immunotherapy-responsive form of encephalitis. However, it is not known which immunotherapy regimens improve short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk. Further, it is not known if the widely-utilised modified Rankin Scale (mRS) accurately captures quality of life (QoL) in LGI1-Ab-E, complicating disability measurements and interpretation of immunotherapy responses. A multicentre, international, real-world comparative analysis of patients with LGI1-Ab-E. Retrospective data from patient records evaluated short-term seizure and cognitive outcomes, 1-6 year disability, and future relapse risk associations, by integrating demographics, clinical features investigations and exposures to immunotherapies and antiseizure medications (ASMs). Patient- and neurologist-rated QoL assessments were used to establish an evidence-based mRS threshold for defining clinically significant disability. Cox proportional hazard models, Anderson-Gill, and generalised linear mixed-effects models were employed. 181 patients were included, with median age at onset 63 years (range 23 - 92); 122/181 (67%) were male. Short-term outcomes, evaluated at both five and ten weeks post-treatment initiation, identified exposure to immunotherapies associated with seizure resolution (OR = 13.97, 95%CI = 6.10-32.01; p < 0.0001 and OR = 8.53, 95%CI = 4.14-17.55; p < 0.0001, respectively), notably with corticosteroids, plasma exchange and rituximab, but not ASMs, intravenous immunoglobulins or steroid sparing agents. Conversely, seizure recurrence was observed after discontinuation of oral prednisolone, but not other immunotherapies or ASMs (OR = 39.53, 95%CI = 12.70-122.20, p < 0.0001). To evaluate longer-term disability, first, mRS scores were calibrated using QoL assessments: this identified a significant increase in patient-rated disability at mRS score of 2. Hence, using mRS 0-1 as a favourable outcome, we identified worse mRS at nadir associated with greater one-year disability (OR = 2.56, 95%CI = 1.56–4.20, p = 0.0003), and each month of delayed immunotherapy associated with a 16% increased risk of disability (HR = 1.16, 95%CI = 1.06-1.35, p = 0.004). Additionally, absence of immunotherapy associated both with greater one-year disability (OR = 5.67; 95% CI 1.19-26.54, p = 0.03) and a relapsing course (OR = 7.64, 95%CI = 2.51-21.77, p = 0.0002). Both a relapsing course, observed in 38% of patients, and the number of relapses associated with step-wise worsening of disability and QoL-outcomes. Rituximab exposure was the only identified clinical factor associated with reduced future relapse risk, by 93% (HR = 0.07, 95%CI = 0.01-0.48, p = 0.002). Persistent serum LGI1-IgMs, but not LGI1-IgGs, at one-year, associated with future relapses (HR = 11.69, 95%CI = 1.58-145.80, p = 0.02). Distinctive clinical factors and select immunotherapies, particularly intravenous methylprednisolone and plasma exchange, but not ASMs, associated with favourable short-term outcomes, patient-centric longer-term disability and relapses in LGI1-Ab-E. Our findings provide evidence-based disability thresholds, highlight novel prognostic biomarkers, and pragmatically guide LGI1-Ab-E care, pending randomized clinical trials.
abstract_zh: 摘要：富含亮氨酸的胶质瘤抑制蛋白1（LGI1）抗体脑炎（LGI1-Ab-E）是一种常见且对免疫治疗有反应的脑炎形式。然而，目前尚不清楚哪些免疫治疗方案能改善短期结果、长期残疾和复发风险。此外，广泛使用的改良Rankin量表（mRS）是否能准确反映LGI1-Ab-E患者的生活质量（QoL）也未知，这使得残疾测量和免疫治疗反应的解释变得复杂。本研究为一项多中心、国际、真实世界的比较分析，涉及LGI1-Ab-E患者。通过回顾性分析患者记录，评估短期癫痫和认知结果、1-6年残疾以及未来复发风险关联，整合人口统计学、临床特征、检查结果以及对免疫治疗和抗癫痫药物（ASMs）的暴露。使用患者和神经科医生评估的QoL评估来确定基于证据的mRS阈值，以定义临床显著残疾。采用Cox比例风险模型、Anderson-Gill模型和广义线性混合效应模型。共纳入181名患者，发病中位年龄63岁（23-92岁）；122/181（67%）为男性。短期结果在治疗开始后五周和十周均评估，发现暴露于免疫治疗与癫痫缓解相关（OR=13.97，95%CI=6.10-32.01；p<0.0001；OR=8.53，95%CI=4.14-17.55；p<0.0001），尤其是皮质类固醇、血浆置换和利妥昔单抗，但与ASMs、静脉免疫球蛋白或类固醇抑制剂无关。相反，停用口服泼尼松后观察到癫痫复发，但其他免疫治疗或ASMs未见复发（OR=39.53，95%CI=12.70-122.20，p<0.0001）。为评估长期残疾，首先使用QoL评估校准mRS分数：发现mRS 2分时患者自评残疾显著增加。因此，使用mRS 0-1作为良好结果，发现最低mRS分数与一年后残疾增加相关（OR=2.56，95%CI=1.56-4.20，p=0.0003），每延迟一个月的免疫治疗与残疾风险增加16%相关（HR=1.16，95%CI=1.06-1.35，p=0.004）。此外，缺乏免疫治疗与一年后残疾增加（OR=5.67；95%CI=1.19-26.54，p=0.03）和复发性病程（OR=7.64，95%CI=2.51-21.77，p=0.0002）相关。38%的患者出现复发性病程，复发次数与残疾和QoL结果的逐步恶化相关。利妥昔单抗暴露是唯一与未来复发风险降低93%相关的临床因素（HR=0.07，95%CI=0.01-0.48，p=0.002）。一年后持续存在的血清LGI1-IgM（但非IgG）与未来复发相关（HR=11.69，95%CI=1.58-145.80，p=0.02）。独特的临床因素和特定免疫治疗，特别是静脉甲泼尼龙和血浆置换，而非ASMs，与LGI1-Ab-E的短期良好结果、以患者为中心的长期残疾和复发相关。本研究提供了基于证据的残疾阈值，突出新的预后生物标志物，并在随机临床试验前为LGI1-Ab-E的护理提供务实指导。
